reviews.text: My Gigi stays here every day! She has been coming since she was a baby and they treat her with lots of love and care! She has a lot of fun and has made a lot of friends. She absolutely loves the pool and plays with all of the dogs in her group. I can’t thank Cara, Joseph, Austen, Lauren, Ashley, and Evelyn enough for their love and dedication. Gigi is the happiest camper when she stays at Woodland Lodge. Ah! And they also do a grest job grooming her 💕. Gigi is so lucky to come here every day!

Ive been boarding my 3 dogs here for about 5 years now and they are wonderful. We absolutely trust them with our fur babies blindly as they take care of them as their own. They also have super cute activities and special perks like Valentine’s Day photo shoots and so much more. Nothing like feeling like having ease of mind when on vacation!

Can’t thank the staff at Woodland pet resort enough for taking care of our pet Coco. They went above and beyond to make her feel comfortable, she is very anxious specially when away from the family. We were a little concerned because she’s a picky eater but she felt so comfortable with them that was eating all her meals. We also looked forward to the reports and pictures every day. I can’t recommend them enough.

I stopped by for a tour before deciding where to board my pet, and I was really impressed. The staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and took the time to answer all of my questions. The facility was beautiful, clean, and well-maintained, which gave me a lot of confidence that the pets are well cared for. You can tell they truly care about the animals and take pride in what they do. I would definitely recommend checking them out if you’re looking for a trustworthy place to board your pet!

I have always had a wonderful experience with Woodland Pet Resort. The staff, accommodations, and care provided to my dog have been excellent, and I want to make it clear that my concern is not with the resort itself or the majority of the team.

My concern is with Joe, one of the assistant managers. I had a question regarding whether my dog should have been allowed to stay based on a situation that occurred. When I attempted to discuss my concern and ask questions, I was met with a very defensive and confrontational response. I was not given the opportunity to explain my concern, and I was told that they had “let me slide” last time and that I was not going to give him “an attitude.”

I was disappointed by the way this interaction was handled. As a pet owner, I believe questions and concerns should be met with professionalism, patience, and open communication. I truly value the care my dog receives at Woodland, and I hope this feedback helps improve communication and customer service moving forward.

My puppy Roo has been coming to the Lodge since she was just a little baby. She absolutely has a blast every time she stays at Woodland, not just with the other dogs but with the staff as well. All the employees are welcoming and friendly, doing their best to help Roo transition to her vacation. They also follow directions well and meet any specific needs or requests I have for my fur baby. We love it at Woodland Lodge!!

We just had our pup Titan board at  Woodland Lodge and we had a great experience! The staff was very attentive and kind. We love that there are cameras and we were able to check in on our pup from time to time. We can tell he had a great time! We also love the daily report card and photos that were sent to us. It made us smile and feel at ease while we were away from our pup. I highly recommend this place if you want to board your pup or for daycare. The staff is very friendly and were happy to answer any questions we had. We can tell they really care about the animals staying there and the specific needs of your pup  We will return again in the future. Thank you Woodland Lodge!

Extremely disappointed with my experience at Woodland Lodge Pet Resort Miami.

I booked a full-day daycare including the required assessment after being told by staff that the assessment could be done the same day followed by daycare. This information was later completely contradicted.

While monitoring the daycare cameras, I repeatedly saw my dog left alone in a closed room, crying and howling, while other dogs were outside playing. Staff gave inconsistent explanations, including “nap time” and “private group play” — a service not disclosed anywhere on their website. I was also told the daycare schedule on their website is “from 2017,” which is unacceptable if customers are expected to rely on it when booking.

Despite booking until 5:45pm, I was called before 4pm and told my dog was “ready for pickup.” At pickup, my dog was visibly distressed, and staff struggled to put on her basic harness, raising serious concerns about supervision and training.

This experience caused unnecessary stress for both my dog and my family. The service provided did not match what was advertised or promised. I would not recommend this facility.

This is my puppy’s second home. Everyone is fantastic and he loves going to daycare. I couldn’t recommend them enough. They send photos and report cards each day and it just gives me the biggest peace of mind to know he’s somewhere fully cared for.

Thank you to all the staff at woodland Lodge for taking care of our little guy while we were away! We LOVED receiving the report cards with the adorable photos! We also loved that the deluxe rooms are decorated like little cabins with a cozy feel,  TV, doggy webcam to view your pet  and a little private grass area they can access when the doggy door is open. Having the webcam was amazing and brought us so much comfort and peace. Everyone was very friendly and answered all our questions and gave us updates when we asked. I would highly recommend booking here for your future pet boarding needs. The only feedback I would like to give is that I wish the dogs had a little bit more outdoor time. However overall, amazing job and facility. Thank you, we will be back soon!

If you need a place for your puppies to go while your on vacation Woodlands is the place for you, They not only took care of our Dogs but kept us updated daily with report cards and photos ! Joe the Manager was awesome he helped us feel comfortable and secure when we left our puppies at woodlands lodge pet resort in Doral. This place was amazing and my dogs loved their stay, I highly recommend this place to anyone! Thanks again !

This is the ONLY place I trust with my mastiff, Kodak. The team goes above and beyond to note every detail to your pets care and needs through their thorough pet profile and questionnaire. The facility is beautiful and incredibly well kept and clean. The daily report cards, photos and video check-ins made my day while we were apart. Also, every toy and belonging was cleaned and returned at his pick up. Thank you, Woodland Lodge team!

My senior dog has never stayed anywhere else that wasn’t my home and for this reason I was worried how he’d react but Woodland Lodge exceeded my expectations!  I appreciated the variety of house food and extra treats that they offer, as well as their planned activities and schedule.  My dog had also never been swimming before and appreciated that the staff noticed this quickly and put a life jacket on him when it was his playtime.  The report cards with pictures were a huge added bonus, thank you so much Woodland Lodge!

Our very spoiled fur babies love it here! They are great with dealing with all of our special requests! Pups get very excited when we arrive. We appreciate the updates while we are away. We love the staff!

Amazing staff! Woodland lodge treats our fur babies as If It were their own. They are very cautious and are willing to meet any specific needs your pet may have. I love being able to watch my dogs on the pet cam during play time! Also, you get a daily report card from the staff via email with photos of your baby! You even have the flexibility of calling or texting the resort If you have any questions or concerns. Thank you so much Woodland Lodge ❤️
